features.heading: What the platform gives you
features.supplyChain.title: Signed supply chain
features.supplyChain.body: Every push is built with buildpacks, scanned, SBOM-attested and cosign-signed. Unsigned images never start.
features.gitops.title: GitOps delivery
features.gitops.body: Argo CD syncs deploy/ and Argo Rollouts shifts traffic in canary steps. A revert is the rollback.
features.observable.title: Observable
features.observable.body: Served behind the platform gateway with TLS, metrics and logs collected without any setup.
features.adharUi.title: Adhar UI
features.adharUi.body: Design tokens, Tailwind preset and accessible component variants — light and dark out of the box.
